{{Quote|Ondorru was with them! Lord Ondorru, the Sith we were trying to take out on Fest! He's here, now, on Belsavis!|Adan|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Adan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Dagger Wing]], a unit of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Like the rest of the unit, Adan was imprisoned in [[Belsavis prison]] after the [[bombing of Fest]], and joined his unit in helping the prison staff keep order. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Adan and his friend [[Myles (Dagger Wing)|Myles]] accompanied their commander [[Conrad Gall]] to secure [[Maximum Security Pod J-P7]], but Gall and a number of pilots pursued a group of Imperials led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ondorru]]&mdash;the man who had tricked Dagger Wing into attacking civilians on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. Adan and Myles stayed hidden until they were found by [[Havoc Squad]], and told the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] about Gall's departure.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adan appears in the Trooper class mission "Slicing the Net" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If players do not complete the bonus mission "Commando Hunt" on the way to Maximum Security Pod J-P7, Adan will be shot and killed by the Imperial commandos that the player was supposed to kill. This article assumes 100% completion, and thus that Adan survived.<ref name="TOR" />
